The '''Ablajeck sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It neighbored the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]: both were located in the [[Inner Zuma Region]] of the Outer Rim along with [[Spar sector]].<ref name="gamer9" /> [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] within the sector included [[Xal 3]].
